# P03 preservation compatibility

`schema11.sql` is a stopped dump of the actual synthetic P02 compiled smoke
snapshot `.tools/progress-test-2QS17c/snapshot.db`, before the schema-12 change.
It contains synthetic task/artifact/progress history and exact receipts. Paths are
historical identifiers; replay does not access them. No credentials or retained
file contents are included.

`requests.json` freezes the version-1 preview/plan and observation request
structures. Observations are generated by the daemon; caller-supplied snapshots
and authority are refused. Store tests retain all earlier fixtures (6 through 11)
and compare events, state, exact command receipts and stopped backups.

`events-v1.json` is the compiled synthetic P03 acceptance event stream from
`.tools/preservation-test-tEkauf`, including mirror, committed, published, missing
source and offline observations. Tests reject forged stages, destinations,
versions, authority and chains, then replay after the originals have vanished.
